TOY MECHANISM TRACE

Cascade-Correlation on XOR

Question and garden context

Explanatory question: what changes when a stalled fixed linear readout gains one selected, frozen hidden feature?

MECHANISM COMPARISON

Do not call every added node “more hidden capacity”

GNG and GWR grow prototypes and graph topology in input space. DNC and Cascade-Correlation add hidden features inside a supervised predictor. Their nodes, signals, and consequences are different.

Not human-reviewed.
Automated source-grounded synthesis; inspect the linked limits.
